name: CHANGED_FLAG
notes: set on every record in observed files; low bits vary (1,2..)

name: HEADER
notes: followed by version string ending in

name: MESH
notes: u8 skeletally_animated, then sub-chunks; stored length wrong in v1.41/v1.8: read children while their id belongs to this chunk

name: SUBMESH
notes: str material, u8 use_shared, u32 index_count, u8 idx32, indices, sub-chunks; stored length wrong in v1.41/v1.8: read children while their id belongs to this chunk

name: SUBMESH_OPERATION
notes: u16 operation type (4 = triangle list)

name: SUBMESH_BONE_ASSIGNMENT
notes: u32 vertex, u16 bone, f32 weight

name: SUBMESH_TEXTURE_ALIAS
notes: str alias, str texture

name: GEOMETRY
notes: u32 vertex_count, then declaration + buffers; stored length wrong in v1.41/v1.8: read children while their id belongs to this chunk

name: GEOMETRY_VERTEX_ELEMENT
notes: OgreVertexElement

name: GEOMETRY_VERTEX_BUFFER
notes: u16 bind_index, u16 vertex_size, then BUFFER_DATA

name: GEOMETRY_VERTEX_BUFFER_DATA
notes: vertex_count * vertex_size bytes

name: MESH_SKELETON_LINK
notes: str skeleton file

name: MESH_BONE_ASSIGNMENT
notes: u32 vertex, u16 bone, f32 weight

name: MESH_LOD
notes: v1.41/v1.8: str strategy, u16 levels, u8 manual, then MESH_LOD_USAGE children (stored MESH_LOD length is wrong); v1.100: skip by length

name: MESH_BOUNDS
notes: f32x3 min, f32x3 max, f32 radius

name: SUBMESH_NAME_TABLE_ELEMENT
notes: u16 index, str name

name: EDGE_LISTS
notes: skipped

name: POSES
notes: skipped for now

name: ANIMATIONS
notes: skipped for now

name: TABLE_EXTREMES
notes: skipped

name: MESH_LOD_USAGE
notes: child of MESH_LOD; its length is reliable in all versions

name: HEADER
notes: followed by version string

name: BLENDMODE
notes: u16 animation blend mode (v1.80)

name: BONE
notes: OgreBone; stored length excludes the name: 36 = no scale, 48 = with f32x3 scale (scale iff length > 36)

name: BONE_PARENT
notes: u16 child handle, u16 parent handle

name: ANIMATION
notes: str name, f32 length, then BASEINFO?, TRACK children (read by content)

name: ANIMATION_BASEINFO
notes: str base animation, f32 base key time

name: ANIMATION_TRACK
notes: u16 bone handle, then KEYFRAME children

name: ANIMATION_TRACK_KEYFRAME
notes: f32 time, f32x4 rotation, f32x3 translate, optional f32x3 scale (same length rule as BONE)

name: ANIMATION_LINK
notes: str skeleton file, f32 scale
